integrity: The finite upper and lower witnesses are embedded, specified in the result, and reproducible by a standard-library checker using exhaustive independent source generation and exact nonnegative integer inequalities. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for Stirling permutations with five doubled labels under one matched-label-pair deletion and standardization; no capacity claim at other orders or under arbitrary two-position deletions. A highly relevant 2014 multipermutation-deletion paper could only be assessed from its abstract, and historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact one-pair-deletion capacity of five-label Stirling permutations
